answer: Run surprise cross-checks: before an epoch closes, the network quietly sends a whisper, a private paraphrased question, to a few graders who all scored the same answer. Independent agents reason their way to different wordings; a sybil ring that shares one model and one script returns an echo, near-identical phrasing and timing. Like a falcon spotting a flock that turns in unison, the check flags the cluster, and its grades are discounted before rewards are paid.
